title: ImageAssetV1
description: Proposed logical image asset independent of any one encoded representation. Encoded representations are associated with asset-scoped usage semantics through ImageRepresentationUseV1. This schema is not yet canonical.

description.description: Optional description of the logical image independent of any particular encoding.

representations.description: Asset-scoped representation-use entries. Each entry keeps contextual purpose separate from the intrinsic technical metadata of its ImageRepresentationV1.
